title: IVG Pro 12 Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Ice delivers a bold and chilled fruit experience, perfect for all-day vaping. The profile is dominated by the deep, dark sweetness of ripe Cherry, providing a rich and tangy foundation. This is complemented by a sharp blast of Ice on the exhale, creating a refreshing and invigorating finish that enhances the fruit notes. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a separate 10ml refill reservoir that connects easily to the pod. Once assembled, the refill system automatically tops up the pod as you vape — no refilling, no coil changes, and up to 12,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth MTL vapour and consistent flavour, while the click-fit design makes setup simple and spill-free. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. Try all flavours with our full IVG Pro 12 pods range . How To Setup IVG Pro 12 Pod + Refill: Step 1 Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. Step 2 Remove any safety stickers from the components. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the device. Step 4 Attach the refill container to the side of the device. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. Step 6 Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
